title: Installer, Updater, Recovery and Offline Media Architecture
requirements: all source installers pass their own SHA-256 manifests
offline media is deterministic and independently verifiable
installation occurs through a sibling staging directory
destination must be a child of an explicit allowed root
updates reject unverified integrity unsigned publisher same version and implicit downgrade
offline ZIP is not labeled as ISO
publisher signing remains external until credentials and authority exist
distribution_boundary: No public publisher signature or ISO image is claimed. Current media is an integrity-verified internal offline ZIP.
